subject.title: fix(ui): prevent Nostr profile publish/import hangs

question: Should Control UI Nostr profile publish/import enforce an unconditional 30-second client deadline, or should its deadline derive from a bounded gateway operation contract?
rationale: Bounded failure is clearly preferable to an indefinite hang, but the maximum duration that may terminate a valid slow operation is a product and compatibility choice that source inspection cannot safely determine.

options.title: Derive the gateway contract
options.body: Define a bounded server-side maximum and set the Control UI deadline slightly above it so stalled work terminates without arbitrarily cutting off valid operations.

options.title: Confirm a fixed 30 seconds
options.body: Accept that any publish or import exceeding 30 seconds fails in Control UI and document and test that value as the supported contract.

recommendation.title: Derive the gateway contract
recommendation.body: Define a bounded server-side maximum and set the Control UI deadline slightly above it so stalled work terminates without arbitrarily cutting off valid operations.
